preconditions.description: The number of plus and minus operators is equal to the number of erased operators in the expression.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '0123456789()?' for c in E)
preconditions.description: The expression E contains only digits, parentheses, and question marks.
The expression E has balanced parentheses.

postconditions.description: The output is the maximum possible value of the expression E after replacing '?' with P plus and M minus operators.
